<p>Purging varied images instantly purges all content variants for that URL. This behavior occurs so that if an image changes, you can easily update the cache with a single purge request instead of trying to determine the potential number of out-of-date variants. The behavior is true regardless of <a href="/cache/how-to/purge-cache/">purge type</a> used, such as <a href="/cache/how-to/purge-cache/purge-by-single-file/">single file</a>, <a href="/cache/how-to/purge-cache/purge-by-tags/">tag</a>, or <a href="/cache/how-to/purge-cache/purge-by-hostname/">hostname</a>.</p>
